entities.name: UE radio capability ID
entities.description: An information element that may be included in WB-S1 mode to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE when both UE and network support RACS.

entities.name: RACS supported by UE and network
entities.description: Condition that both the UE and the network support RACS (Radio Access Capability Signaling).

entities.name: WB-S1 mode
entities.description: Condition that the UE is operating in WB-S1 mode.

entities.name: Network assigns UE radio capability ID
entities.description: Property indicating the network needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE.

relations.description: The inclusion of UE radio capability ID IE is guarded by the condition that the UE is in WB-S1 mode.
The inclusion of UE radio capability ID IE is guarded by the condition that both UE and network support RACS.
The inclusion of UE radio capability ID IE establishes that the network needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE.
